name: House of Representatives of Cyprus
notes: 56 seats (the 24 Turkish Cypriot seats have been vacant since 1985), as elected on 24 May 2026: DISY 17, AKEL 15, ELAM 8, DIKO 8, ALMA 4, Direct Democracy 4. Counts from published reports of the official result (Cyprus Mail, Robert Schuman Foundation, Wikipedia); parliament.cy and the Interior Ministry results site could not be read by script, so the split is not checked against the parliament's own member list and later changes were not checked. Aristos Damianou (AKEL, Nicosia) is named in the election report but is not lit: no post-election list from parliament.cy could be read (the only archived member list, 1 May 2026, is the previous House), so his position stays unchecked.
